headline: Ikeja Hotel Posts 15% Rise in Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit to N8.19 Billion
summary: Ikeja Hotel Plc reported a 15.1% increase in pre-tax profit to N8.19 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to N7.12 billion in the same period of 2025.
why: Ikeja Hotel owns major hospitality properties in Lagos, providing a benchmark for commercial travel and corporate lodging demand in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Ikeja Hotel
impacts.why: A 15% increase in pre-tax earnings reflects resilient occupancy rates and lodging revenues.
